metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Questionable for Week 8
metadata.description: Skowronek (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek strung together three consecutive limited practices while working through a calf injury, which has prevented him from playing in each of the Steelers' last two games. His status for Sunday's AFC North may become more clear depending on whether the Steelers elect to elevate Brandon Johnson from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) listed questionable for Sunday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (calf) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
metadata.analysis: The veteran wideout will have a chance to play on Sunday. His calf injury has left him sidelined for a little while, but he seems to be close to full health at this point. He won't be fantasy relevant moving forward, however, even if he's cleared to make his return to the lineup on Sunday.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Logs another limited practice
metadata.description: Skowronek (calf) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek has missed each of Pittsburgh's past two games due to the calf issue. His ability to begin Week 8 prep with consecutive limited sessions gives the veteran wideout a chance to return Sunday versus Cleveland, though he'll likely carry a designation into the weekend if he's not able to log a full session Friday. When healthy this season, Skowronek has seen limited opportunities on offense, recording just three catches for 32 yards and a touchdown on four targets through five contests.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) limited participant Thursday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (calf) was a limited participant in practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was limited for another practice session on Thursday. That's a step in the right direction for him, however, as he has missed multiple games due to the calf injury that's bothering him. He remains off of the injury report moving forward, regardless of his health status.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) limited in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek was limited in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek remains off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Limited at practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Skowronek (calf) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek has missed the Steelers' last two games with a calf injury he sustained back in Week 5 versus the Colts, and now his availability for Week 8 is up in the air. Whether he ends up suiting up Sunday versus the Browns might hinge on whether he's able to upgrade to full participation at practice Thursday or Friday.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Ruled out Week 7
metadata.description: The Steelers have ruled Skowronek (calf) out for Sunday's matchup against the Saints, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek did not participate in Wednesday's practice. He will now miss his second straight week due to a calf injury suffered in the Steelers' Week 5 win against the Colts. Kaden Wetjen may see some extra reps in his place.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) won't play Week 7
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (calf) won't play in Week 7's matchup against the New Orleans Saints.
metadata.analysis: The veteran wideout is going to miss another game due to the calf issue that he's recovering from. Rookie Germie Bernard was already expected to see a lot of work in this game, but this move clears his path to a large workload even more.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) absent from practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (calf) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The veteran wideout wasn't able to practice on Wednesday thanks to a calf issue that he's still dealing with. He may very well be sidelined again in Week 7, which wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Idle for Wednesday's practice
metadata.description: Skowronek (calf) did not practice Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was unable to play against the Buccaneers in Week 6 due to a calf injury that he sustained during the Steelers' Week 5 win over the Colts. He'll have two more chances to log at least a limited practice ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Already ruled out for Week 6
metadata.description: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Skowronek (calf) will not play against the Buccaneers this Sunday, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was diagnosed with a leg injury during the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts, which he picked up after a punt return in the first half. He was unable to return to the contest, and his calf issue will cost him at least one game, with his next chance to play being Week 7 against the Saints in Paris on Sunday, Oct. 25. Roman Wilson (finger) has also been ruled out for Week 6, so rookie second-rounder Germie Bernard, Kaden Wetjen and Brandon Smith are all in line for additional snaps on offense against Tampa Bay.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) ruled out for Week 6
metadata.description: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Ben Skowronek will not play in Week 6 against the Buccaneers.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek left Sunday's game early against the Colts with a calf injury. He is week-to-week for now.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) ruled out
metadata.description: The Steelers have ruled out WR Ben Skowronek (calf) for the remainder of the game with the Colts.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek and Roman Wilson will not return for the Steelers in the second half. He did not receive a target prior to his injury.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Downgrades to out Sunday
metadata.description: Skowronek (leg) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Colts, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek exited the game with a leg injury after a punt return and was ruled questionable to return. After further evaluation, it has been determined that the wide receiver will not return to Sunday's contest, leaving Brandon Smith as the No. 4 option.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Questionable to return in Week 5
metadata.description: Skowronek (leg) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was injured during a Steelers punt and is now in danger of missing the remainder of the Week 5 meeting with Indianapolis. The 29-year-old logged only eight offensive snaps in the Week 4 loss to the Browns, though his departure from the contest, even if it's brief, will be felt on special teams.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Notches TD in Week 3
metadata.description: Skowronek hauled in his lone target for a 23-yard touchdown during Sunday's 30-27 win over the Bengals.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek ranked fifth among Steelers receivers by playing 11 of the team's 62 offensive snaps, but the 29-year-old was able to connect with quarterback Aaron Rodgers on a pass to the end zone during his limited time on the field. Despite coming up with a big play in the Week 3 win, Skowronek remains likely to see most of his field time on special teams moving forward.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek finds the end zone in Week 3 win
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek caught his lone target for 23 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
metadata.analysis: The 29-year-old veteran made the most of his lone target Sunday. Fantasy managers can leave Skowronek on the waiver wire for now.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Clears concussion protocol
metadata.description: Skowronek (concussion) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was placed in concussion protocol at the end of August after the wide receiver suffered a head injury in the Steelers' 28-27 preseason loss to the Bills. The 29-year-old progressed through the entirety of the league's five-step protocol and was cleared by an independent neurologist before Wednesday's first official practice.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Placed in concussion protocol
metadata.description: Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's 28-27 preseason loss to the Bills, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek has entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol. The wide receiver will need to be cleared by an independent neurologist to ultimately be cleared for game action. If the 29-year-old cannot recover from the injury by the Steelers' Week 1 showdown with the Falcons, Kaden Wetjen projects to fill the No. 5 wide receiver role.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Quiet during 2025 regular season
metadata.description: Skowronek secured four of six targets for 69 yards and a touchdown while appearing in all 17 regular-season games in 2025.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek had a 22-yard touchdown reception in the Steelers' Week 1 win over the Jets, but his production went downhill from there. He failed to garner multiple targets in any of his regular-season appearances, and he was forced to play mainly on special teams during his fifth professional campaign. The 2021 seventh-rounder will be an unrestricted free agent during the offseason, and it wouldn't be surprising to see him seek out other opportunities after being held under 70 receiving yards in each of his two seasons in Pittsburgh.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Cleared for Sunday
metadata.description: Skowronek (illness/hand) doesn't have an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Similar to last week, Skowronek managed to log a full practice on the final day of the week to be cleared of any injury designation heading into gameday. This marks consecutive weeks that the wide receiver will play through a hand injury. The 28-year-old played just four offensive snaps last week with no targets, making his living on 65 percent of special teams snaps. This week will likely be no different for Skowronek, who sits behind DK Metcalf, Calvin Austin, Adam Thielen, and Marquez Valdes-Scantling on the wide receiver depth chart.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (illness/hand) limited Thursday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (illness/hand) was limited at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was once again limited at practice on Thursday as he continues to deal with a hand injury and a minor illness of some kind. It remains to be seen whether or not he will play in Week 16, but his status doesn't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Skowronek (illness/hand) was limited in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek dealt with the hand issue last week in practice, but the illness is new for the special-teams standout and wide receiver. Skowronek has posted a career-high 19 tackles (nine solo) in kick coverage for Pittsburgh.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - No injury designation for MNF
metadata.description: Skowronek (hand) was not given an injury designation for Monday's clash against Miami.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek didn't practice Wednesday due to the hand issue, but he was able to finish the week with consecutive limited sessions. Those will be enough for the veteran wideout to take the field against the Dolphins on Monday Night Football. Skowronek has seen most of his work on special teams of late, as he has logged just 13 offensive snaps as opposed to 29 special-teams snaps over the past two weeks.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Limited in practice Friday
metadata.description: Skowronek (hand) was a limited participant in Friday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was unable to practice Wednesday, so an upgrade in participation level is a good sign for the wide receiver's chances of playing in Monday night's game against the Dolphins. The 28-year-old will have one more opportunity to upgrade to a full participant and avoid an injury designation for Monday's game.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (hand) sidelined at practice Thursday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (hand) was sidelined at Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was one of Pittsburgh's players who were not able to practice on Thursday due to an injury. He doesn't see much work even when fully healthy for the Steelers, however, so his potential absence in Week 15 wouldn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Sits out practice Thursday
metadata.description: Skowronek (hand) did not participate in Thursday's practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek dealt with a shoulder injury during practice Week 14 but managed to suit up for the Steelers' win over Baltimore without any sort of designation. Now, however, the depth wideout's status appears uncertain due to a hand issue. Skowronek will have two more opportunities to get back on the practice field ahead of Monday's matchup against the Dolphins.
